summary.text: Dominique Azzollini is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 139 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Jeff Olsommer.
A real estate professional from Milford, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running on healthcare access, affordability and regulating data centers.

paragraphs.text: Dominique Azzollini earned a high school diploma from Delaware Valley High School, and her career experience is in real estate.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she graduated in 2018 and attended Wilkes University's Honors College, studying neuroscience and psychology, before putting her studies on hold in 2020 and entering the workforce.

She said she then worked as an administrative assistant for a local real estate company in Milford, earned her real estate license, and now helps residents with the local housing market and home-buying process.
Azzollini's survey responses name more accessible healthcare, a more affordable cost of living and regulating data centers as her key messages.
She also said she supports raising the minimum wage, creating opportunities for first-time home buyers, term limits, and keeping foreign money out of local politics.
